description: Run a language-game context and return its state plus the cell's own self-evaluation of the rendered frame - integer score 0-1000 over occupancy, spread, contrast and edge quality, with the C4 span correction applied. Stateless: (kind, seed, t, n, at_seq) fully determine the result.

at_seq.description: decimal string, pinned corpus epoch. e.g. 1

kind.description: the language-game context kind: atc, proteins or materials, e.g. proteins

max_iter.description: decimal string, iteration cap, default 10. e.g. 10

seed.description: decimal string; JSON numbers still admitted. e.g. 7

target.description: decimal string, refine until score >= this (0-1000, default 950). e.g. 950

name: game_frame_meta
